name: MedQA (USMLE)
description: Multiple-choice questions from US medical licensing exams (USMLE Steps 1, 2, 3).
usecase: The gold standard for evaluating clinical reasoning. Train models to pass medical board exams.

name: MedMCQA
description: 194k multiple-choice questions from Indian medical entrance exams (AIIMS and NEET PG) across 21 subjects.
usecase: Large-scale medical knowledge evaluation. Best dataset for training models on broad medical facts.

name: PubMedQA
description: Yes/No/Maybe questions grounded in PubMed research abstracts. Tests evidence-based reasoning.
usecase: Train and test evidence-based medicine. Evaluate whether a model can read an abstract and answer a clinical question.

name: PubHealth (HealthFact)
description: Public health claims labelled as true, false, mixture, or unproven. Sourced from fact-checking organisations.
usecase: Build health misinformation detectors. Evaluate claim verification for RAG systems.

name: MedNLI
description: Natural language inference pairs derived from MIMIC-III clinical notes. Tests clinical text entailment.
usecase: Train models to understand contradiction and entailment in clinical documentation. Key for EHR QA systems.

name: NCBI Disease
description: PubMed abstracts annotated with disease mentions, normalised to MeSH or OMIM concepts.
usecase: Train disease NER models. Evaluate entity extraction pipelines for clinical text.

name: BC5CDR
description: Chemical and disease mentions in PubMed articles. Annotated for NER and chemical-disease relation extraction.
usecase: Drug-disease relation extraction, pharmacovigilance pipelines, chemical NER.

name: MIMIC-IV
description: De-identified EHR data from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center ICU. Notes, labs, vitals, medications.
usecase: Pre-training clinical LLMs, mortality prediction, ICU outcome modelling, clinical note generation.

name: MIMIC-CXR
description: Chest X-ray images paired with radiology reports from BIDMC. Largest public chest X-ray dataset with text.
usecase: Radiology report generation, chest X-ray finding classification, multimodal health models.

name: CheXpert
description: 224k chest X-rays from Stanford Medicine with 14 radiological findings labels, including uncertainty labels.
usecase: Chest X-ray classification, abnormality detection, radiology AI training.

name: NIH Chest X-ray14
description: 112k frontal chest X-rays with 14 disease labels from NIH Clinical Center. Classic radiology AI benchmark.
usecase: Chest pathology classification, pre-training visual encoders for multimodal health models.

name: VQA-RAD
description: Clinician-generated QA pairs on radiology images (CT, MRI, chest X-ray). Tests visual medical reasoning.
usecase: Train and evaluate multimodal radiology AI. Benchmark for medical visual question answering.

name: MedMentions
description: PubMed abstracts with mentions linked to UMLS concepts. The largest public biomedical NER dataset.
usecase: Fine-grained biomedical NER, medical knowledge graph population, concept normalisation.

name: BioASQ
description: Expert-curated biomedical QA from PubMed. Includes yes/no, factoid, list, and summary question types.
usecase: Biomedical IR systems, evidence synthesis, multi-type medical QA training.

name: HEAD-QA
description: Spanish healthcare exam questions translated to English. Covers medicine, pharmacy, nursing, psychology, chemistry, biology.
usecase: Evaluate models across multiple healthcare disciplines. Good for multi-specialty health AI assessment.

name: MedQuAD
description: 47k medical QA pairs from 12 NIH websites covering diseases, drugs, treatments, and research.
usecase: Patient-facing medical chatbots, health information retrieval, consumer health QA.

name: MedDialog
description: 1.1M medical dialogue datasets in English and Chinese between patients and doctors.
usecase: Train patient-facing medical chatbots, symptom checker dialogues, conversational health assistants.

name: Medical Meadow
description: Diverse medical instruction-tuning dataset combining flashcards, wikidoc, stack exchange, and more.
usecase: Fine-tuning general LLMs for health tasks. Comprehensive instruction-tuning corpus for medical alignment.

name: eICU Collaborative Research Database
description: Multi-site ICU database covering 200k patient stays from 208 US hospitals. Richer demographic diversity than MIMIC.
usecase: ICU outcome prediction, treatment recommendation, multi-site clinical model training.

name: PubMed-RCT
description: Sentences from PubMed RCT abstracts labelled by role: background, objective, methods, results, conclusions.
usecase: Abstract structure prediction, evidence extraction from clinical trials, structured summary generation.

name: DDI Extraction
description: Drug-drug interaction annotations from DrugBank and MedLine. Standard pharmacological NLP benchmark.
usecase: Drug safety NLP, pharmacovigilance, relation extraction for drug interaction detection.

name: SIDER
description: Side effect and indication database covering 1427 drugs with 5880 adverse effects from drug package inserts.
usecase: Adverse drug event prediction, drug labelling NLP, pharmacovigilance model training.

name: JNLPBA
description: Biomedical NER covering DNA, RNA, cell types, cell lines, and proteins from MEDLINE abstracts.
usecase: Genomics NLP, biomedical entity recognition for biology-focused models.

name: PubMed Abstracts
description: The complete PubMed archive of biomedical and life sciences journal abstracts. Updated daily.
usecase: Pre-training or continuing pre-training of biomedical LLMs. Building medical search and RAG indexes.

name: CORD-19
description: 1M+ scientific papers on COVID-19 and related coronaviruses with full-text and metadata.
usecase: Pre-training on infectious disease literature, evidence retrieval for RAG pipelines.

name: PhysioNet ECG Databases
description: ECG signal databases including MIT-BIH arrhythmia, PTB-XL. Annotated for rhythm and morphology.
usecase: Arrhythmia detection, ECG classification, multimodal cardiac AI combining signals and clinical text.

name: ClinVar
description: NCBI archive of relationships between genomic variation and human health with clinical significance labels.
usecase: Variant pathogenicity prediction, genomic report generation, precision medicine NLP.

name: BioRED
description: Biomedical relation extraction dataset with multi-type entity pairs: gene, disease, chemical, variant.
usecase: Multi-type biomedical relation extraction, knowledge graph construction, drug-gene-disease links.

name: MS²
description: Multi-document summarization dataset from medical systematic reviews. Pairs multiple RCT abstracts with review summaries.
usecase: Evidence synthesis, systematic review automation, multi-document clinical summarization.

name: Medical-O1 Reasoning SFT
description: Medical reasoning chain dataset with step-by-step clinical reasoning traces. 90k samples with detailed thought processes for medical questions.
usecase: Fine-tuning LLMs for chain-of-thought medical reasoning. Teach models to reason through clinical problems step by step.

name: Medical Reasoning SFT (GPT-OSS 120B)
description: 200k medical reasoning SFT samples generated by a 120B open-source model. High-quality chain-of-thought annotations.
usecase: Large-scale medical instruction tuning. Best for training models on high-quality clinical reasoning traces.

name: HealthCareMagic 100k
description: 100k real patient-doctor conversations from HealthCareMagic platform. Covers a wide range of medical conditions and symptoms.
usecase: Train medical chatbots and virtual assistants. Best real-world dataset for patient-doctor conversation modelling.

name: Mental Health Counseling Conversations
description: High-quality mental health counseling conversation pairs between patients and therapists. Carefully curated for safety.
usecase: Fine-tune LLMs for empathetic mental health support, crisis response, and therapeutic dialogue systems.

name: Medical Questions Pairs
description: Pairs of similar medical questions with labels indicating whether they are duplicates. Sourced from medical forums.
usecase: Medical question deduplication, semantic similarity for health chatbots, QA retrieval systems.

name: Wiki Medical Terms
description: Medical terms and their definitions scraped from Wikipedia. Clean, structured glossary-style entries.
usecase: Medical terminology fine-tuning, glossary-grounded RAG, medical concept explanation training.

name: Clinical Trials History
description: Comprehensive historical dataset of clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov with structured metadata and outcomes.
usecase: Clinical trial outcome prediction, protocol generation, trial eligibility matching, evidence synthesis.

name: LOINC Clinical Terminology
description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes — the universal standard for lab tests, vital signs, and clinical measurements.
usecase: EHR standardisation, lab result NLP, interoperability tasks, clinical code prediction.

name: ICD-10 Clinical Terminology
description: ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS diagnosis and procedure codes with descriptions. The standard for medical coding.
usecase: Automated ICD coding, clinical coding assistance, diagnosis classification from clinical notes.

name: Medical Transcription Dataset
description: Medical transcription samples across 40 specialties. Real clinical documentation covering various medical specialties.
usecase: Medical transcription NLP, clinical specialty classification, medical note generation across specialties.

name: Medical Guidelines (Meditron Training Data)
description: Curated medical clinical practice guidelines from major health organisations. Used to train Meditron.
usecase: Fine-tuning LLMs on authoritative medical guidelines. Grounding health AI in evidence-based clinical recommendations.

name: Medical Meadow Flashcards
description: Medical flashcard Q&A pairs covering pharmacology, anatomy, physiology, and clinical medicine.
usecase: Medical knowledge instruction tuning. Good for teaching factual medical knowledge in a Q&A format.

name: Clinical Information Extraction
description: Clinical information extraction dataset from MIT. Annotated clinical notes for structured information extraction.
usecase: EHR information extraction, clinical NER from free text, structured data extraction pipelines.

name: PubMed Central Open Access
description: Full-text open access papers from PubMed Central covering all biomedical specialties.
usecase: Pre-training or domain adaptation of biomedical LLMs. Building knowledge-rich RAG indexes for health AI.
